messages.subject: Quartz House, Reading - heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Good to be working with you. Attaching our client's marked heads of terms for Quartz House. We've added a six-week exclusivity in your client's favour and a confidentiality provision. Subject to contract throughout.

We'll have the data room open by the end of the week.

Martin Greaves
Marlowe Greaves LLP
